analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit across 3 Solidus documentation sites crawled 1558 pages with 100% coverage of discovered URLs (1642 total). 78 confirmed broken internal links exist within user-facing documentation. API reference coverage is 0%, despite 264 API pages detected, indicating no usage examples or integration guidance. 58.6% of pages lack freshness metadata, and SEO/geo issues affect 13.61% of content. Overall audit confidence is 79.05%, with API coverage confidence at only 55%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100% of 1642 discovered pages within scope)
Multi-version documentation strategy in place (edge, stable, legacy guides)
risks: 78 broken internal documentation links create poor user experience and navigation failures
Zero API reference coverage (0.0%) means no usage examples or integration patterns for 264 detected API pages
Multi-site documentation topology (3 separate sites) creates discoverability and consistency risks
41.4% of pages missing last-updated metadata undermines content trustworthiness
SEO/geo issue rate of 13.61% impacts search discoverability and international reach
API coverage confidence only 55% suggests potential detection limitations in methodology
4 unverified links excluded from analysis due to auth/rate-limit barriers may hide additional issues

limitations: External audit cannot verify actual code execution or functional correctness of 92.77% example reliability estimate
